156497.overview:
Caccia al Ladro Isidoro & Sonja was a handheld game released in 1982.

The game's title roughly translates to "Chase The Thief Heatcliff & Sonja"
This is one of the few times Heatcliff has appeared on a VTech product.

190408.overview: Independence Day is a handheld LCD electronic video game developed by Tiger Electronics, based on the movie Independence Day from 1996.

190486.overview: Gakken Invader 2000 is a classic, red-cased tabletop/handheld electronic game released in 1982 that utilizes a vibrant Vacuum Fluorescent Display (VFD). It is a highly sought-after collectible piece of retro gaming history.

190487.overview:
It's an invasion from Outer Space and you must defend your missile
bases on Earth from the computer-controlled space invader attack.
You have 5 missile bases and 5 chances to launch a counterattack.
Watch out, here they come. Fire.

It's a game of speed as well as skill. If the invaders reach the Earth's
atmosphere, the game is over even if you have missile bases left.

462397.overview:
LSI Game Invader tasks the player with defending Earth from waves of alien attackers descending from the upper reaches of the screen. Promoted as a “portable version of authentic Invader,” it condenses the arcade concept into a vertical handheld battle, where the player’s cannon fends off a slow, methodical invasion.

The player controls a ground-based cannon using a three-position slider to move left or right, firing upward with a single red button. Rows of alien ships appear at the top of the VFD screen, inching downward each time the player fires. Destroying all invaders advances the level; missing too many shots allows them to close in. The game ends when the aliens breach the base. The VFD display glows in green and blue hues, with scoring displayed numerically above the playfield.

479671.overview:
Wowsers! Inspector Gadget, the worlds greatest detective, needs your help! Deep in the jungle lies the Lost City of Gold, where Dr. Claw and his gang of thugs plan to cash in and rule the world! Inspector Gadget has help from his niece Penny, his loyal dog, Brain - and of course, you! Help Inspector Gadget use three of his favorite gadgets - Go Go Gadget Skates, Go Go Gadget Legs and Go Go Gadget Arms to get him out of trouble! Travel through four stages of jungle excitement and pick up as much gold as you can before Dr. Claw gets it

There's a mean gorilla waiting for Inspector Gadget in the jungle. Gadget must grab the gold bricks before the evil Dr. Claw gets them, and before the gorilla goes ape!

Help Inspector Gadget dodge the dirtballs that Dr. Claw tries to hit him with!

You will be rewarded by Brain if you can defeat Dr. Claw before he defeats you! You get a trophy from Brain and bonus points added to your score!
